payload.title: PSS IMP-PROV-03: migrate Codex and Claude into Providers-owned execution adapters

Codex and Claude each load identity/capability metadata from the Providers-owned catalog and register through the accepted execution registry.

Prove canonical request mapping, ordered progress/tool/message drafts, exactly one terminal result, cancellation/timeout normalization, safe diagnostics, and provider-session metadata through behavioral conformance and focused functional tests.

payload.title: Packaged Factories Story 7: initialize and materialize embedded catalog selections
payload.objective: Complete the remaining customer-facing Packaged Factory initialization behavior now that the Clean CLI contract and embedded catalog are accepted. A customer or bootstrap operation can select a packaged Factory by public name and materialize an editable, portable Factory directory through Factory Definitions without introducing a second catalog or redesigning CLI commands.
scope: Use the existing packaged-factories manifest and embedded Factory Definitions distribution/materialization contracts as the only first-party source.
Make system initialization enumerate the manifest deterministically and make every supported packaged Factory resolvable by name.
Route the already accepted customer-facing initialization command through a service-owned Factory Definitions CLI adapter; preserve the accepted command, flag, completion, error, and output contract.
Materialize editable prompts, scripts, and assets into the requested directory with established non-overwrite or explicit replacement semantics and no package-internal paths.
Reject unknown names with stable available-name diagnostics and reject incompatible scaffold/package options without partial writes.
Prove idempotency, format selection where already accepted, rollback on partial failure, portability outside the repository, and invocation of a representative materialized Factory.
Do not redesign or regenerate the CLI schema, change top-level Cobra composition, edit provider catalogs, or create a handwritten Factory inventory.
acceptanceCriteria: All supported manifest entries are resolvable through Factory Definitions and a selected packaged Factory materializes through the canonical materializer.
Materialized outputs are editable and portable, restore package assets, contain no repository/package-internal paths, and preserve observable invocation behavior.
Existing targets follow established safe overwrite semantics; invalid selection or write failure leaves no partial installation.
The accepted CLI initialization behavior delegates through the service-owned adapter without changing command/flag/error/output/completion contracts.
Focused distribution/materialization, CLI parity, portability, and public functional tests pass together with relevant package and verification gates.
